svg.title: How the ordinary Boxster roof folds behind the seats
svg.desc: Four proportioned side cutaways show the closed, clearance, folding and stowed snapshots of the ordinary MY2010 Boxster 2.9 powered roof. The manual catch travels with the front frame. Fabric and lining fold around articulated supports while the rear glass remains a single rigid pane. The separate compartment cover rises locally behind the roll-over bar and closes over the folded package. The rear luggage lid stays fixed. The near-side body is cut away over the roof well. Pivots, cloth folds and intermediate poses are illustrative; real movements overlap.

g.text: 5 Roof well behind the seats · neither boot is used
1 motor → 2 flexible rotary shafts → left/right gearboxes
Jointed rods and levers move the roof and its cover together.
Photo-guided cutaway; illustrative poses and pivots.
Real movements overlap. Use the handbook for operation.
